title: Sources: a faction of Nvidia board members is pushing for Jensen Huang's return despite Chair Harvey Jones stating the board has no plans to reinstate Huang (Semafor)
summary: Semafor: Sources: a faction of Nvidia board members is pushing for Jensen Huang's return despite Chair Harvey Jones stating the board has no plans to reinstate Huang — Despite Nvidia's proclamation Tuesday that it didn't plan to bring ousted CEO Jensen Huang back to the chipmaker …
